input.title: getDescendantThoughts: Share contexts queue
input.body:
## Problem

- a
  - m
  - n
  - o
  - (1000 more)
- c
  - d
    - e

On initial load, `a` and `c` are loaded and their descendants are fetched by `getDescendantThoughts` via the `pullQueue`. Both `a` and `c` are collapsed and their descents are loaded in the background. 

If the user navigates to `c/d` as soon as the root context is rendered, loading `e` will be very slow since the provider is busy fetching all of the children of `a`. 

## Solution

The [contexts](https://github.com/cybersemics/em/blob/989cd2ee9ea955c20becd467a036ed6d39f4f085/src/data-providers/data-helpers/getDescendantThoughts.ts#L38) queue internal to `getDescendantThoughts` should be shared across calls so that newer requests are bumped to the top of the queue. 

## Requirements

Propose and, once approved, implement a solution that exhibits good encapsulation and appropriate couplings.
